title: Databricks Hits $190 Billion Valuation! Launches 'Lakebase' To Give AI Persistent Memory
summary: Data and AI platform Databricks raised $5 billion in a funding round led by Coatue, soaring to a $190 billion valuation. The capital will accelerate enterprise agentic infrastructure, headlined by Lakebase, a serverless PostgreSQL database engineered as durable state memory for AI agents.
raw_text: Honestly, this is huge for the future of enterprise software! Databricks just secured a staggering five billion dollars in fresh funding led by Coatue, pushing their total valuation to a massive one hundred and ninety billion dollars. But here is the wild part: all that cash is laser-focused on solving the single biggest flaw of generative AI—statelessness. Right now, large language models forget everything the moment an API call finishes. To fix this, Databricks is building 'Lakebase,' a serverless PostgreSQL backend baked directly into their Unity Catalog that serves as permanent short-term and long-term memory for autonomous agents built on LangGraph and OpenAI SDKs. By marrying durable state-stores with enterprise lakehouses, data engineers can run low-latency agent workflows with rock-solid security. They also backed UK consultancy Advancing Analytics to roll this out to regulated industries. We are watching the memory layer of autonomous AI get built right in front of our eyes!
